# PDMP3

From https://github.com/technosaurus/PDMP3 at 2a206a3ada78ec4d13434847f05f50097c60c36a,
unmodified. Public domain (Unlicense, in the file header).

Used for one table: `g_synth_dtbl`, ISO/IEC 11172-3's 512 synthesis window coefficients, read
by `tools/mp3tables/gen.py` into `ref/mp3/tables/synth_window.zig`.
